maintenance_led.reason: Sells Apligraf, Dermagraft, PuraPly and other wound-care tissue products for new patient treatments, not servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Wound care products like Apligraf and Dermagraft are largely reimbursed by Medicare, including physician-office and outpatient use.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own regenerative products and new facilities, such as Smithfield; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Clinicians can choose competing skin substitutes and wound products; switching involves some reimbursement familiarity but not deep lock-in.

notes: Medicare share of revenue is from general knowledge, not the website text.
